description:
Save a new email, rather than a reply, in the mailbox's Drafts folder. It sends nothing, and this MCP has no send operation for it. Supported HTML: p, br, strong/b, em/i, u, s, a (http, https, mailto, tel), ul, ol, li, blockquote, code, pre, h2, h3, span/mark with the composer's styles, and inline cid: images. h1 becomes h2. Tables and h4-h6 are not supported: their text stays as paragraphs and removed_formatting lists them ('table' for any table part, 'h4', ...), as it lists other dropped elements such as script, style or iframe. Attributes and inline styles outside the composer set are dropped and not reported. Paragraphs are already spaced like the Shipmail composer, so do not add


between them. When html is given without text, the text part is derived from it.

id.description: Mailbox ID whose Drafts folder receives the draft.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

name: shipmail_create_draft

id.description: Names the file in the stored draft as it is now. It changes after every update; read the draft again for current ids.
The draft's id. It stays the same when the draft is corrected.

message_id.description: Inbox message that holds the draft now. It changes with every correction.

removed_formatting.description: Formatting the HTML sanitiser dropped: 'table' for any table part, 'h4' to 'h6', and other dropped elements such as 'script'. Their text stays as paragraphs.

review_url.description: Link for a person to review this one draft and send it, or null for a test-mode key. The person must be signed in with access to the mailbox. Opening it sends nothing, and it stops working once the draft is sent or deleted, or a person replaces it in the inbox. A correction through the API keeps it working.

title: Save New Email Draft
